name: ACP
description: ACP host mode. Run minimal-agent as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent over stdio. Editors (Zed, JetBrains, others) can then drive it with no custom glue. Level 1 covers initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel and session/set_config_option (model, effort). Level 1 also covers text/thought streaming, tool-call, usage and notice updates, and ACP stop-reason mapping. The approval gate (session/request_permission) is off by default. Use --approval to set it on.

hostModes.description: Agent Client Protocol v1 over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0 / NDJSON).
